task.title: Tighten tests and rough edges left by the v0.7.0 story reviews
task.description:
Small items the reviews of PRs #221-#224 left open. None blocked a merge.

- Board (#221): there is no end-to-end `serve` test of the board's unknown-status region against a real repository.
- Due dates (#222): `--due +1D` (upper case) is accepted but the docs show only lower case; decide which is right and make them agree. The projection's schemaVersion bump is covered only indirectly by a test.
- Moving tasks back (#223): a board save made in the first seconds after a place is marked as left gets no warning. A second unfinished move after an earlier round trip can print the setup advice where move-tasks is the right command (the setup refusal just repeats; harmless).
- Reset (#224): not exercised in review: a kill in the middle of `git bundle create` itself, a kill between two push batches (needs more than 500 refs), a real hosting service's ref-protection rule (a local hook stood in), and stopping the watcher on Windows.

Do not add guards against two people running move-tasks or reset at the same moment: teams coordinate those (Dylan, 2026-11-22).
